articles.author: Mohd Haider
articles.headline: Samsung Cuts US Jobs, Tariff Wars Escalate and More: This Week in Economics
articles.summary: This week’s economic roundup covers Samsung layoffs, tariff disputes, oil markets, regulatory shifts, and global trade developments.
articles._summary: It’s been another eventful week on the economic front, with tariff battles, corporate restructuring and regulatory appointments setting the stage for what’s ahead. Here’s a quick recap of the major economic stories that came in over the week. President Donald Trump imposed new tariffs of 10% to 12.5% on imports from 60 trading partners as a temporary global levy expired, targeting countries with weak enforcement against forced-labor goods.
articles._zh_headline: 三星在美国裁员、关税战升级等：本周经济
articles._zh_summary: 经济方面，本周又是多事之秋，关税战、企业重组和监管任命为未来奠定了基础。以下是本周发生的主要经济事件的快速回顾。随着全球临时征税期满，唐纳德·特朗普总统对来自 60 个贸易伙伴的进口产品征收 10% 至 12.5% 的新关税，针对强迫劳动商品执法不力的国家。

articles.author: Mohd Haider
articles.headline: Apple Hits Record Highs, Eyes Foldable Market Share, Tim Cook's Final Earnings Call and More: This Week in Appleverse
articles.summary: This week’s Apple roundup covers record stock highs, leadership changes, foldable ambitions, and optimism ahead of quarterly earnings.
articles._summary: Apple touched an intraday all-time high of $334.99, pushing the stock to its richest valuation in company history as AI-driven optimism reshaped investor sentiment. Toni Meadows of BRI Wealth Management said Apple was once viewed as an AI laggard, but that perception has shifted. Shares were up more than 20% year-to-date and over 54% across the past year heading into Cook’s final quarter at the helm. Apple shares are trending higher ahead of the company’s Jul.
articles._zh_headline: 苹果创下历史新高、关注可折叠市场份额、蒂姆·库克的最终财报电话会议等：本周 Appleverse
articles._zh_summary: 由于人工智能驱动的乐观情绪重塑了投资者的情绪，苹果盘中触及 334.99 美元的历史新高，将该股股价推至公司历史上最高的估值。 BRI 财富管理公司的托尼·梅多斯 (Toni Meadows) 表示，苹果曾被视为人工智能落后者，但这种看法已经发生转变。年初至今，该公司股价上涨了 20% 以上，去年在库克掌舵的最后一个季度，股价上涨了 54% 以上。苹果公司的股价在该公司 7 月份之前呈走高趋势。

articles.author: Mohd Haider
articles.headline: Iran War Escalates, Political Divides Deepen and Streaming Giants Face World Cup Roadblock and More: This Week in Politics
articles.summary: This week’s political roundup covers Iran tensions, Trump’s statements, Treasury sanctions, and debates over media rights.
articles._summary: It’s been another eventful week, with political leaders making bold statements and setting the stage for future events. Here’s a quick recap of the major political stories that came in over the week. Hunter Biden argued the country isn’t as divided as it seems but is instead being deliberately split by wealthy elites who benefit from the conflict. He called for a “New New Deal” centered on healthcare, affordable housing, and an end to endless wars, and proposed an AI-driven dividend for all Americans.
articles._zh_headline: 伊朗战争升级，政治分歧加深，流媒体巨头面临世界杯障碍等：本周政治
articles._zh_summary: 这又是多事的一周，政治领导人发表了大胆的声明，并为未来的事件奠定了基础。以下是本周发生的主要政治故事的快速回顾。亨特·拜登认为，这个国家并不像看起来那么分裂，而是被从冲突中受益的富裕精英故意分裂。他呼吁制定以医疗保健、经济适用住房和结束无休止战争为中心的“新新政”，并提议为所有美国人提供人工智能驱动的红利。

articles.author: Benzinga Neuro
articles.headline: David Sacks Warns Anthropic Doesn't Want Competition: 'You're Going to Basically Put a Dagger Through the Heart of the Entire American Open Source Ecosystem'
articles.summary: Sacks accuses Anthropic of stifling competition in the AI industry, warns against restricting open-source models as it could harm US ecosystem.
articles._summary: David Sacks , Co-Chair of the President’s Council of Advisors on Science and Technology, accused Anthropic of trying to stifle competition in the AI industry, warning that efforts to restrict open-source AI models could cripple the broader U.S. AI ecosystem. Speaking on a recent episode of the All-In Podcast , Sacks argued that labeling Chinese open-source AI models as tainted by intellectual property theft would discourage American developers from building on publicly available models.
articles._zh_headline: David Sacks 警告 Anthropic 不希望竞争：“你基本上会把匕首刺入整个美国开源生态系统的心脏”
articles._zh_summary: 总统科学技术顾问委员会联合主席 David Sacks 指责 Anthropic 试图扼杀人工智能行业的竞争，并警告说，限制开源人工智能模型的努力可能会削弱更广泛的美国人工智能生态系统。萨克斯在 All-In Podcast 最近的一期节目中表示，将中国开源人工智能模型贴上知识产权盗窃的标签会阻止美国开发者在公开可用的模型上进行开发。

articles.author: Mohd Haider
articles.headline: Samsung, Broadcom Ink $200 Billion AI Chip Pact Through 2030 as Foundry Race With TSMC Heats Up
articles.summary: Samsung and Broadcom signed a partnership projected above $200 billion to advance AI chips, memory and semiconductor manufacturing.
articles._summary: The five-year agreement combines Broadcom’s expertise in designing application-specific integrated circuits with Samsung’s chip manufacturing capabilities. Under the deal, Broadcom’s next-generation communication chips will be produced using Samsung’s sub-2-nanometer process technology, according to Samsung. The two companies will also work together to develop advanced high-bandwidth memory technologies, including HBM4E and HBM5.
articles._zh_headline: 三星与博通签署 2030 年价值 2000 亿美元的人工智能芯片协议，与台积电的晶圆代工竞赛愈演愈烈
articles._zh_summary: 这项为期五年的协议将博通在设计专用集成电路方面的专业知识与三星的芯片制造能力结合起来。三星表示，根据协议，博通的下一代通信芯片将采用三星的亚2纳米工艺技术生产。两家公司还将共同开发先进的高带宽内存技术，包括 HBM4E 和 HBM5。

articles.author: Snigdha Gairola
articles.headline: Demis Hassabis Backs Jensen Huang's AI Vision, Says 'A Strong and Secure Open Ecosystem Is Important' for Global AI Growth
articles.summary: Demis Hassabis backs open AI models as Nvidia’s Jensen Huang says the future needs both open and closed frontier AI systems.
articles._summary: On Saturday, Hassabis shared Huang’s post on X , supporting Nvidia’s position that open AI models play a critical role in advancing innovation, security and global access to AI. "A strong and secure open ecosystem is important for the world to benefit from AI," he wrote. He highlighted Google DeepMind’s contributions to open science and AI development, including projects such as JAX, Transformers, AlphaFold and Gemma open models.
articles._zh_headline: Demis Hassabis 支持黄仁勋的人工智能愿景，表示“强大且安全的开放生态系统对于全球人工智能增长非常重要”
articles._zh_summary: 周六，哈萨比斯在 X 上分享了黄仁勋的帖子，支持 Nvidia 的立场，即开放人工智能模型在推动创新、安全和全球人工智能获取方面发挥着关键作用。他写道：“强大而安全的开放生态系统对于世界从人工智能中受益非常重要。”他强调了 Google DeepMind 对开放科学和人工智能开发的贡献，包括 JAX、Transformers、AlphaFold 和 Gemma 开放模型等项目。

articles.author: Crispus Nyaga
articles.headline: Micron Stuck in a Bear Market: Will it Rebound or Crash Further?
articles.summary: Micron stock has pulled back in the past few weeks and moved into a bear market as analysts remain optimistic about the company
articles._summary: The options market is not sending a clear signal about Micron’s near-term outlook. Data shows that implied volatility has climbed to about 99%, indicating that investors expect heightened price swings. Meanwhile, the put-to-call ratio stands at 1.19, suggesting a modest bearish or hedging bias rather than aggressive bearish positioning. Wall Street analysts are optimistic that Micron has more upside to go. Benzinga data shows that the consensus target for the stock is $1,268, up by 37% from the current level.
articles._zh_headline: 美光陷入熊市：会反弹还是进一步崩盘？
articles._zh_summary: 期权市场并未发出有关美光近期前景的明确信号。数据显示，隐含波动率已攀升至99%左右，表明投资者预期价格波动加剧。与此同时，看跌期权与看涨期权比率为 1.19，表明温和的看跌或对冲偏见，而不是激进的看跌头寸。华尔街分析师乐观地认为美光科技还有更大的上升空间。 Benzinga 数据显示，该股的共识目标为 1,268 美元，较当前水平上涨 37%。

articles.author: Crispus Nyaga
articles.headline: Why is Salesforce the Worst-Performing Dow Jones Stock?
articles.summary: Salesforce stock has plunged sharply in the past few years and is the top laggard in the Dow Jones Index as growth concerns remain
articles._summary: CRM stock has fallen in the past few years amid concerns about its revenue and market share growth. Most recently, the retreat has been because of the ongoing SaaSPocalypse concerns. SaaSPocalypse is the fear that artificial intelligence agents will ultimately disrupt and take market share from software companies. These AI tools are expected to become more powerful over time. Just this week, OpenAI confirmed that its AI tool had successfully hacked Hugging Face .
articles._zh_headline: 为什么 Salesforce 是表现最差的道琼斯股票？
articles._zh_summary: 由于对其收入和市场份额增长的担忧，CRM 股票在过去几年中一直在下跌。最近，撤退是因为持续存在的 SaaSPocalypse 担忧。 SaaSPocalypse 是对人工智能代理最终会颠覆并夺取软件公司市场份额的担忧。随着时间的推移，这些人工智能工具预计将变得更加强大。就在本周，OpenAI 确认其 AI 工具已成功破解 Hugging Face。

articles.author: Crispus Nyaga
articles.headline: Behind the Gold Price Drop? Falling ETF Inflows as US Bond Yields Jump
articles.summary: Gold price has dropped in the past few days as data shows that top gold ETFs like GLD and IAU are seeing strong outflows
articles._summary: Gold prices have slumped into a bear market this year, even as geopolitical risks rose. The metal has fallen by over 27% from its January high, underperforming the stock market. This retreat is likely due to falling ETF inflows and rising bond yields. Demand for gold among American investors has waned this year as many of them have rotated to the memory sector.
articles._zh_headline: 金价下跌的背后？美国债券收益率飙升，ETF 流入量下降
articles._zh_summary: 尽管地缘政治风险上升，金价今年仍陷入熊市。该金属已较 1 月份高点下跌超过 27%，表现逊于股市。这种回撤可能是由于 ETF 流入量下降和债券收益率上升所致。今年美国投资者对黄金的需求有所下降，因为他们中的许多人转向了内存行业。

articles.author: Crispus Nyaga
articles.headline: Tesla, Intel, Google All Dropped After Earnings - Will Microsoft, Amazon, Meta Follow?
articles.summary: Top tech stocks like Tesla, Intel, and Google dropped after earnings. So, what will Microsoft, Meta, and Amazon do after results?
articles._summary: Microsoft stock has already plunged by over 30% from its all-time high. Similarly, Meta and Amazon have dropped by 25% and 18% from their all-time highs, erasing billions of dollars in value. These companies will publish their financial results next week, with analysts expecting their growth to continue. Benzinga data shows that analysts expect Meta Platforms’ revenue to come in at $60 billion, up by 26% YoY. Its EPS is expected to rise modestly to $7.22.
articles._zh_headline: 特斯拉、英特尔、谷歌均在财报公布后股价下跌——微软、亚马逊、Meta 会效仿吗？
articles._zh_summary: 微软股价已较历史高点下跌逾 30%。同样，Meta 和亚马逊的价值也较历史最高点下跌了 25% 和 18%，蒸发了数十亿美元。这些公司将于下周公布财务业绩，分析师预计它们的增长将继续。 Benzinga 数据显示，分析师预计 Meta Platforms 收入将达到 600 亿美元，同比增长 26%。其每股收益预计将小幅上涨至 7.22 美元。

articles.author: Shomik Sen Bhattacharjee
articles.headline: Elon Musk Built Tesla and SpaceX While Working Over 100-Hour Weeks. He Says 'Vacations Will Kill You' and the Reasons Behind It Are as Chaotic as You'd Expect.
articles.summary: Elon Musk, founder of SpaceX and CEO of Tesla, is known for working over 100 hours a week and linking it to vacation disasters.
articles._summary: Musk said building his companies sometimes required more than 100 hours weekly, and his workload later climbed to about 120 hours after he bought Twitter . "Go to sleep, I wake up, work, go to sleep, work, do that 7 days a week," he said, speaking at the Ron Baron Conference in November 2022. His rare breaks became part of his work mythology. Musk said one week off coincided with explosions involving Orbital Sciences and Virgin Galactic vehicles. During another, a SpaceX rocket exploded.
articles._zh_headline: 埃隆·马斯克 (Elon Musk) 每周工作 100 多个小时，打造了 Tesla 和 SpaceX。他说“假期会杀了你”，其背后的原因正如你所想象的那样混乱。
articles._zh_summary: 马斯克表示，创建自己的公司有时每周需要花费 100 多个小时，而在他收购 Twitter 后，他的工作量后来攀升至约 120 小时。他在 2022 年 11 月举行的 Ron Baron 会议上发表讲话时说道：“睡觉、起床、工作、睡觉、工作，每周 7 天都是这样。”他罕见的休息时间成为了他工作神话的一部分。马斯克表示，休假一周恰逢轨道科学公司和维珍银河公司的飞行器发生爆炸。另一次，SpaceX 的一枚火箭发生爆炸。

articles._zh_headline: 英特尔、特斯拉、IBM 等：本周投资者热议的 5 只股票
articles._zh_summary: 在散户炒作、盈利、人工智能基础设施势头和企业新闻流的推动下，本周（7 月 20 日至 7 月 24 日）散户投资者在 X 和 Reddit 的 r/WallStreetBets 上谈论了五只热门股票。零售焦点包括人工智能基础设施势头、收益和企业新闻驱动的叙述以及本周更广泛的市场走势。英特尔公司（纳斯达克股票代码：INTC）、特斯拉公司（纳斯达克股票代码：TSLA）、Alphabet Inc.（纳斯达克股票代码：GOOG）（纳斯达克股票代码：GOOGL）、国际商业机器公司
